_comment: HOOK MODE: no arguments, payload read from STDIN. This is a HARDENING, not a bug fix, and the distinction is recorded because an earlier commit message of mine got it wrong. The previous registration passed -Route with the CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT placeholder and it WORKED: measured against commit 59b2620 in a real marketplace install, three prompts routed to FORGE, EMPATHIC and CLINICAL correctly. The claim that it shipped dead came from misreading the harness debug log -- the line reads "Hook UserPromptSubmit (UserPromptSubmit) success:" and the hook output is printed on the NEXT line, so grepping only the matching line shows nothing. Hook mode is kept anyway for two measured reasons: it depends on no harness-provided variable, and an empty route makes the ps1 wait on stdin forever (exit 124), which is a real latent hang; and it stops PreToolUse from passing a FABRICATED all-zero gauge vector. Measured: 5 of 5 sessions emit the marker and the lane varies with the prompt.
